Enrollment at Canoe Valley School

We are welcoming enrollment interest from families of students aged 12–18 for our anticipated fall 2027 opening. Admissions and tuition information is forthcoming in January 2027.

Joining the school

We aspire to a first-year enrollment of approximately 15–20 students, and aim to grow within a few years to about 30–40 students in two mixed-age programs, a lower and an upper level.

Our waitlist for fall 2027 is open now. We anticipate significant interest, so please consider adding your family’s name.

Tuition and affordability

In line with our core institutional value of accessibility, we aim to make enrolling at Canoe Valley School as affordable and flexible as we can. Upon accreditation, we will be able to offer families access to the State of Iowa’s Education Savings Account (ESA) program to offset tuition.

To ensure the financial stability and institutional thriving of the school, and in light of the financial picture reported by families in our feasibility study, tuition will also include an annual supplement paid by families in addition to ESA per-pupil funding, set at an accessible level. We are currently exploring scholarship as well as sliding-scale options for the tuition supplement for families in financial need.

Flexible enrollment

The school is also exploring at least one flexible schedule enrollment option: a half-time schedule that would allow students to pursue part of their education at home or at another institution, part at Canoe Valley, and if a high school diploma is desired, to graduate from either Canoe Valley or another institution.

Note that this option would not include access to the ESA program, which requires at least 75% full-time enrollment. Note also that the advancement pathway we are exploring for half-time students will depend on accreditor approval.
